slides.title: POV: you close your kitchen like a restaurant closes at night
Why a closing shift works
slides.body: Restaurants don't wait until it feels dirty. They close at the same time every night. It's a trigger, not a mood.

slides.title: Pick your closing trigger
slides.body: After dinner, after the kids are in bed, or when the dishwasher beeps. Same trigger every night.

slides.title: The 10-minute closing shift
items: Food away, leftovers in clear boxes
Wipe counters, only the open parts

slides.title: Don't hand wash everything
slides.body: Anything that won't fit in the dishwasher goes in the sink with hot soapy water to soak. Morning-you washes it in 30 seconds.

slides.title: Lights off = kitchen closed
slides.body: Turn off the kitchen light when you're done. It's a clear finish line for your brain.

slides.title: Future me walking into a clean kitchen is my love language.
